name: FocalScope
description_en:
FocalScope is a product in the Live chat category. Its directory profile covers Visitor Targeting, Transfers, Shortcut Messages, Persistent Chat, Offline Form, Knowledge Database, Co-Browsing, Call Me Option.

Additional listed capabilities include Agent Scheduling. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as 24/7 (Live rep).

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $9.00. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.
